model.pixel_coordinates: integer pixel centres; top-left centre is (0,0)
model.stereo: parallel axes; same intrinsics; right centre is +baseline along left optical X
model.sampling: synchronized global exposure; equal-weight RGB accumulation at midpoint sub-samples; constant generalized velocity during exposure; timestamp_s denotes exposure start; reference_fps is not a realtime guarantee

vendor_reference.note: Nominal product references, not per-device calibration. Reference mode is 60 fps to accommodate 10 ms exposure; 120 fps has only an 8.33 ms frame period.

intrinsics.note: Lens 2.2 mm and 110x80 degree FOV references come from docs/plan.md, not device calibration. Horizontal FOV 110 degrees is the primary constraint; fx=fy=width/(2*tan(hfov/2)); derive vertical FOV from image height

mount_and_imaging.note: Reuse the official head_booster_stereo_rgb_link optical frame. Shift mount centre 35.1 mm optical-right and 40 mm optical-forward as a virtual clearance assumption, not hardware extrinsics. Zero distortion and ideal rectification. Exposure is a user-selected 10 ms simulation assumption, approximated with 10 RGB samples and constant qvel; no sensor radiometry, acceleration or contact prediction.
